source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pivots = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    def nearby(p):
        r0, c0 = p
        return sum(1 for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row)
                   if v and (r, c) != p and max(abs(r-r0), abs(c-c0)) <= 3)
    source = max(pivots, key=nearby)
    targets = [p for p in pivots if p != source]
    if not targets:
        return out
    sr, sc = source
    offsets = [(r - sr, c - sc, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v and (r, c) != source and max(abs(r-sr), abs(c-sc)) <= 3]
    for tr, tc in targets:
        out[tr][tc] = 0
        for dr, dc, v in offsets:
            r, c = tr + dr, tc + dc
            if 0 <= r < len(out) and 0 <= c < len(out[0]):
                out[r][c] = v
    return out
'''
